== Biography ==
Margaret was baptised on 14 November 1721 at Kirknewton and East Calder, Midlothian. Two derivative Findmypast transcripts name her father as Alexander Glasgow and her mother as Margaret Mubrie.<ref name="FMP1721Margaret">Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929'', [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_686210560 R_686210560] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_691904966 R_691904966], Margaret Glasgow baptism, 14 November 1721, Kirknewton and East Calder, parents Alexander Glasgow and Margaret Mubrie; derivative transcripts inspected 24 October 2026, original register not inspected.</ref> Her birth preceded this baptism; no exact birth date is recorded. An earlier biography linked the father to [[Glasgow-1313|Alexander Glasgow]] and mother to [[Mubrie-1|Margaret Mubrie]]. The maintained selected father is [[Glasgow-1141|Alexander Glasgow]] at 90% within its local-adult identification scope, and the structured mother is [[Moultrie-158|Margaret Moultrie]]; the Mubrie/Moultrie spelling and person-ID equivalence have not been proved by the derivative index.
